goal: Enable funding, creating, and fee-bumping transactions that pay to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Provide receiver privacy and prevent address reuse when sending via Bitcoin Core wallet RPCs or the GUI
agreement: Blocked by unaddressed MSVC build failure and contested anchor filtering logic (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: metadata loss on bumpfee if original transaction is mined later (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: silent payments identity lost across restarts when replaced (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds sending support for BIP 352 Silent Payments
Solves address-reuse and privacy gaps for users paying silent payment recipients
